notes.title: Update v1.0.2 Now Live!
notes.content:
Update v1.0.2 Now Live!

Hello, fellow gamers!

We're thrilled to announce that Update v1.2.0 is now live and packed with exciting new features, gameplay improvements, and bug fixes to enhance your gaming experience. Dive into the details below and see what's new!

[hr][/hr]

 New Features

Blast Cap Target Selection

Player-Controlled Targeting: After placing a Blast Cap, you can now select an enemy cell to attack. This adds a new layer of strategy, allowing you to make tactical decisions to outsmart your opponents.

AI Integration: The AI will intelligently select targets when using the Blast Cap, ensuring challenging and dynamic gameplay even in single-player modes.

Blue Shell Rule Implementation

Comeback Mechanics: Players who are behind in cell count now have increased chances of receiving power mushrooms (rare mushrooms with special abilities).

Balanced Probability: Only mushrooms with a rarity value (PerThousand) less than 500 are considered power mushrooms. The probability of obtaining these is increased for trailing players, helping to level the playing field.

[hr][/hr]

 Gameplay Improvements

Mushroom Growth Patterns Adjusted

Controlled Expansion: Certain mushrooms will no longer grow into visible cells. This prevents unexpected behaviors.

Affected Mushrooms:  Death Cap Ghost NPC Triple Cap Double Blue Double Cap Green Button Blaze Button Lamp Shade Midnight Morel Cap Night Cap Tree Top Brown Cap Boom Cap 

Improved AI Decision-Making

Smarter Opponents: The AI now better evaluates where to place mushrooms based on their types and strategic value.

Enhanced Tactics: AI players consider whether mushrooms perform best near their own territory or near enemies, making single-player matches more engaging.

[hr][/hr]

 Bug Fixes

Fixed Blast Cap Crash: Resolved an issue where the game could crash when the AI placed a Blast Cap. The Blast Cap now functions correctly for both players and AI.

Turn Progression Issue: Fixed a bug where the game wouldn't proceed to the AI's turn after a player placed a Blast Cap. The game now smoothly transitions between turns.

NullReferenceException Fix: Addressed a rare error that could occur during AI mushroom placement, improving overall game stability.

[hr][/hr]

 Balance Changes

Adjusted Mushroom Probabilities

Fair Play: Reworked the probability distribution for mushroom types to balance gameplay, especially in competitive matches.

Power Mushroom Distribution: Trailing players have a higher chance of receiving power mushrooms, making comebacks more achievable and matches more exciting.

[hr][/hr]

 User Interface Enhancements

Enhanced Notifications: Added new in-game messages to guide you when selecting targets for the Blast Cap or when an action isn't possible.

Improved Tooltips: Mushroom tooltips now display more detailed information, helping you make informed decisions during gameplay.


[hr][/hr]

 Miscellaneous

Code Optimization: Refactored parts of the game code for better performance and smoother gameplay.

Stability Improvements: Fixed minor bugs and optimized game systems to enhance stability.

[hr][/hr]

 Thank You for Your Support!

We want to extend a huge thank you to all our players for your continued support and feedback. Your insights are invaluable and help us make the game better with each update.

[hr][/hr]

Happy gaming and see you on the battlefield!

— Crimson Leaf Team



[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Mushroom Moonrise - Update 0.4 Were almost ready!
notes.content:
Mushroom Moonrise - Update 0.4: New Mushrooms, Bug Fixes, and More!

Greetings, fellow mushroom enthusiasts!

We’re excited to announce a brand-new update for Mushroom Moonrise! This patch brings fresh content, essential bug fixes, and gameplay enhancements to enrich your fungal adventures. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we’re thrilled to share these latest additions.

[hr][/hr]

🆕 New Mushroom Types

🌟 BlastCap Mushroom
Description: Meet the BlastCap! This explosive, rocket-shaped mushroom adds a new level of excitement.
Behavior:
 []Targeting: Upon planting, the BlastCap locks onto an enemy cell. []Growth: It matures normally, then launches toward its target during the spore phase. []Explosion: Detonates upon arrival, clearing the target cell and surrounding areas. []Poison Effect: May poison cells for several growth cycles, causing a lasting impact. Strategic Use: Use the BlastCap to disrupt enemy territory in both single-player and versus modes. 

👻 GhostNPC Mushroom
Description: Beware of the GhostNPC, a spectral mushroom that haunts the grid.
Behavior:
 []Moves to adjacent cells each growth cycle, poisoning other mushrooms it encounters. []Strategic Use: Deploy GhostNPCs to sabotage enemy expansions and control key areas. 

💡 Lampshade Mushroom
Description: Illuminate your strategy with the Lampshade mushroom.
Behavior:
 []Interacts with neighboring mushrooms, capable of poisoning GhostNPCs or accelerating friendly mushrooms’ growth. []Strategic Use: Use the Lampshade to support your mushrooms and weaken nearby enemies. 

🍄 Green Button Mushroom
Description: The Green Button is a straightforward mushroom, focused on movement.
Behavior:
 []Moves to a random neighboring cell during growth, updating ownership and visuals upon arrival. []Strategic Use: Efficiently expand territory by spreading Green Buttons across the grid. 

[hr][/hr]

🛠️ New Features and Improvements

🚀 Animated BlastCap Rocket
 The BlastCap now features an animated rocket that launches toward target cells with enhanced explosion effects. 

🌈 Rainbow Road Level Selection
 A new level selection screen with levels unlocking progressively based on your progress, providing more control and clarity. 

[hr][/hr]

🐛 Bug Fixes

🔧 GhostNPC NullReferenceException Resolved: Fixed an error where GhostNPCs caused unintended cell resets.
🔧 Lampshade Stability: Addressed a growth cycle issue with proper null checks, ensuring smooth interactions.
🔧 Green Button Ownership Correction: Updated movement logic for accurate ownership and color feedback.

[hr][/hr]

⚙️ Gameplay Adjustments

🎯 BlastCap Targeting Logic Enhanced: BlastCaps now identify enemy cells more accurately, adapting to both single-player and versus modes.
🌀 Dynamic Targeting for BlastCap: If no target is found initially, the BlastCap will reattempt targeting each growth cycle, increasing its reliability.

[hr][/hr]

📢 Community Spotlight

A big thank you to everyone who provided feedback and suggestions! Your input helps us improve Mushroom Moonrise with each update.

[hr][/hr]

🚀 Update Now!
Fire up Mushroom Moonrise to experience the latest features and improvements. As always, join the discussion on our Steam Community Hub—we’d love to hear from you!

Thank you for your continued support, and happy mushrooming!
